notes.title: v0.63.5 Update
notes.content:
[b]New Stuff:[/b]
- Added Shield Pickup (take no damage for 5 seconds)

[b]Map Changes:[/b]
- visuals/objects in Dungeon Boss Arena have been altered/added

[b]Gameplay Changes:[/b]
- Green XP Orb is now more visible
- Players can no longer out-run XP Orbs and other drops
- Left-over keys will be converted to Souls at the end of the run (1 Key = 50 Souls)
- Fixed Dungeon boss getting stuck on pitfall traps
- Fixed bug where Soul Drops weren't being counted in the Stats panel
- "Refill HP" option changed to "Gain 15% HP" when leveling up after reaching Max upgrades

notes.title: v0.63.2 Update
notes.content:
[h3]Rush Mode:[/h3]
	- Start at level 20
	- Pick your first 20 upgrades right away
	- Timer starts at 5:00 minutes
	- Enemy HP & DMG are equivalent to 5 minutes into a regular game

[h3]General Changes[/h3]
- added rain effects to the main menu

notes.title: v0.63 Update
notes.content:
New Stuff:
- After the player has all max upgrades in a level they will now be given the choice to either gain +10 Souls or Refill the HP Bar upon levelling up

General Changes:
- Removed achievement to kill 1000 Bosses
- Removed achievements that require the player to last 3 hours in each level
- Enemy HP and DMG icons are moved from the top-right corner to the bottom of the screen near the player's HP for better visibility
- Heart Drops will not be picked up by the player if they are already at Max HP
- Enemies and the player no longer get stuck on objects (trees, poles, tombs, etc.)
	***The catacomb-style buildings in the "Dungeon" level are still solid***

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed an issue where clicking "Main Menu" after a run would quit the game completely
- Fixed an issue where players could not pick up the blue orbs in the "Dungeon" level
- Fixed an issue causing players to not get the achievement "More Candy Please"
- Fixed an issue causing players' gamesaves to be deleted upon updating
- Optimizations have been made to the Enemies so the game doesn't become unplayable after the 20 minute mark
